Birch bark box with porcupine quillwork decoration. The basket is part of a nest of three [see 2014.43.3 & .4 for the others]. The main body of the box is made from an inner layer of birch bark with one band of vertical cane strips on the outside. For the decorated lid see 2014.43.5 .2. [CW [OPS move] 15/07/2016]

Birch bark lid with quillwork decoration. The lid is constructed of birch bark with a band of vertical cane strips with the same quill decoration as the body of the box. The lid is decorated with a geometric design of white, yellow and green dyed quills consisting of linear designs and triangles. For the decorated quillwork birch bark box  see 2014.43.3 .1 [CW [OPS move] 15/07/2016].

Birch bark box with decorative porcupine quillwork. The box is part of a nest of three [see 2014.43.4 & .5 for the others]. The main body of the box is made from an inner layer of birch bark with two bands of vertical cane strips on the outside interwoven at spaced intervals with woven white porcupine quill decoration. For the decorated quillwork lid see 2014.43.3 .1 [CW [OPS move] 15/07/2016].
Birchbark basket with hinged lid and quillwork decoration.

Basketry cup [1992.1.1 .1] and saucer [1992.1.1 .2]; physically tied together with a strip of ash. These objects are made of woven of ash splints with sweetgrass trim.  The cup [1992.1.1 .1] is tea-cup shaped with a strap handle of ash on one side and three bands of purple: one below the bundled rim, and two closer to the bottom. The saucer [1992.1.1 .2] has a flat bottom and slightly expanding and curved sides with a bundled rim. There is one band of purple about midway along the dish. [MOBB [OPS move] 2/11/2016]
Round basketry lid. The basket for this lid is 1992.1.4 .1. [MOBB [OPS move] 3/11/2016]
